youtube.title: HTTP 200 Is Not Fresh Data | FreeTrade Open-Source Demo (English)
youtube.description:
A dashboard can be online while its data is stale. FreeTrade makes the difference visible.

This English-narrated walkthrough, with Chinese and English subtitles, shows the research dashboard, five-factor rules, snapshot pipeline, and sanitized observations from 127 retained legacy run logs.

Code and English README: https://github.com/eust-w/freetrade
Videos, subtitles and checksums: https://github.com/eust-w/freetrade/releases/tag/v0.1.1

The dashboard uses clearly labeled synthetic demo data. Historical log counts are observations, not investment returns or a complete scheduling success rate. No hidden AI inference, automated orders, or return claims. This is a software-engineering and research demonstration, not investment advice.

Narration: synthetic macOS Samantha voice. Original diagrams and demo screenshots. No third-party music.

#OpenSource #Python #DataEngineering
